title: One account can read another account's data (needs two accounts)
summary: Account A can read what only account B should see.  This is the cleanest proof of broken object authorization, and it needs both accounts.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.

reproduce: Fetch the same route as account A and account B and compare the bodies.
remediate: Scope every query to the signed in account.
